title: MODFLOW 6 with FULL_3D DISU option for fully unstructured 3D grids (unofficial fork)
description:
Unofficial fork of MODFLOW 6 (MODFLOW-ORG/modflow6, develop 6.9.0.dev0, commit 6565dc81) adding a FULL_3D option to the DISU package. With this option, cells are general polyhedra defined by volume, cell centre and face connections (no cell top/bottom), so that fully unstructured 3D grids, such as 3D Voronoi grids, can be used for groundwater flow and transport, with native VTU output of geometry and results.

This software is not maintained, reviewed, approved or endorsed by the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) or by the MODFLOW development team. The original MODFLOW 6 license and disclaimer are retained. Official MODFLOW 6 releases are available from the USGS.
